json_schema.description: TradeOps earnings transcript facts v1 data payload. Copy normalized DocFlow identity and evidence IDs exactly. Unsupported facts and guidance slots must be null.

schema_version.description: TradeOps earnings transcript facts schema version. Must be exactly 1.

docflow_document_id.description: Copy the exact document_id from the normalized DocFlow document. Do not translate, normalize, shorten, or rewrite this ID.

docflow_fingerprint.description: Copy the exact fingerprint from the normalized DocFlow document. Do not translate, normalize, shorten, or rewrite it.

currency.description: Currency explicitly supported by the transcript, normalized to uppercase. Monetary values must use this currency; downstream TradeOps validation checks it against the instrument.

amount_scale.description: Monetary amount scale. Revenue and net income must be currency base units; diluted EPS must be currency per share.

margin_scale.description: Margin scale. Return margins as decimal fractions, for example 0.42 for 42 percent.

facts.description: Supported current-period earnings facts. Every slot is present; use null when explicit transcript evidence does not support a fact.

revenue.description: Return null when this fact is not supported by explicit transcript evidence.

value.description: Revenue in currency base units. Convert explicitly stated millions or billions to base units.

evidence_segment_ids.description: Exact normalized-document segment IDs supporting this value. Copy each ID verbatim; do not translate, normalize, or rewrite it.

diluted_eps.description: Return null when this fact is not supported by explicit transcript evidence.

value.description: Diluted earnings per share in currency per share.

evidence_segment_ids.description: Exact normalized-document segment IDs supporting this value. Copy each ID verbatim; do not translate, normalize, or rewrite it.

net_income.description: Return null when this fact is not supported by explicit transcript evidence.

value.description: Net income in currency base units. Convert explicitly stated millions or billions to base units.

evidence_segment_ids.description: Exact normalized-document segment IDs supporting this value. Copy each ID verbatim; do not translate, normalize, or rewrite it.

gross_margin.description: Return null when this fact is not supported by explicit transcript evidence.

value.description: Gross margin as a decimal fraction, for example 0.42 for 42 percent.

evidence_segment_ids.description: Exact normalized-document segment IDs supporting this value. Copy each ID verbatim; do not translate, normalize, or rewrite it.

operating_margin.description: Return null when this fact is not supported by explicit transcript evidence.

value.description: Operating margin as a decimal fraction, for example 0.18 for 18 percent.

evidence_segment_ids.description: Exact normalized-document segment IDs supporting this value. Copy each ID verbatim; do not translate, normalize, or rewrite it.

guidance.description: Supported guidance facts. Every slot is present; use null when explicit transcript evidence does not support an item.

direction.description: Return null unless the transcript explicitly supports a guidance direction.

evidence_segment_ids.description: Exact normalized-document segment IDs supporting the guidance direction. Copy each ID verbatim; do not translate, normalize, or rewrite it.

revenue_low.description: Return null when this fact is not supported by explicit transcript evidence.

value.description: Low end of revenue guidance in currency base units.

evidence_segment_ids.description: Exact normalized-document segment IDs supporting this value. Copy each ID verbatim; do not translate, normalize, or rewrite it.
